components.name: HeroSection
components.doc: A full screen landing page hero in three designs: a product screenshot in perspective over a drifting mesh, a live workflow graph that routes sample events, and editorial type over a mesh gradient.

components.name: HeroSectionBlock
components.doc: Preview: the hero, full screen, with a small glass switch floating over its top edge. The switch takes no space of its own, so every design fills the screen exactly. Switching replays the entrance.

components.name: HeroNav
components.doc: The bar across the top of a hero: brand, section links, and the way in.

components.name: HeroBackdrop
components.doc: The faint grid of solid dots behind a hero. Set `--dots-fade` on it (a mask image) to choose where the grid fades out.

components.name: HeroMark
components.doc: One phrase of a headline under a solid accent marker that draws in from left to right.

components.name: ActionLink
components.doc: A link or button that looks like an ryan-ui button. Links keep native navigation; a button with `doneLabel` confirms in place.

components.name: HeroContent
components.doc: The hero with your own content: announcement, headline, description, actions, an optional install line, and an optional visual beside the copy. Use it when none of the three designed variants fits the product.

components.name: HeroLumen
components.doc: Centered hero, one full screen: a headline over a drifting mesh, and a live revenue dashboard rising from the bottom edge. The window settles from a tilt as it enters and runs off the bottom of the screen into a fade. It is real markup built from ryan-ui charts; its range control works.

components.name: HeroRelay
components.doc: Split hero, one full screen: the copy beside a live workflow graph on a dotted canvas. Sample Stripe events arrive on their own and run the workflow node by node; the data draws along each edge, the branch decides which actions run, and every step reports its time. "Send test event" runs the next sample at once. The run pauses off screen, and under reduced motion each event shows its finished run without playing.

components.name: HeroCadence
components.doc: Minimal hero, one full screen: large type over a slowly drifting mesh gradient with grain, and the teams that use the product along the bottom edge.

members.name: variant
members.doc: `centered` is a headline over a drifting mesh with a live dashboard rising from the bottom edge, `split` sets the copy beside a live workflow graph that runs sample events node by node, and `minimal` is large type over a mesh gradient. Each design fills one full screen.

members.name: animateIn
members.doc: Plays the entrance once on mount. Defaults to true.

members.name: primaryAction
members.doc: The main call to action. With `doneLabel` and no `href`, the button confirms in place.

members.name: secondaryAction
members.doc: The second call to action.

members.name: title
members.doc: Your own headline. When set, the hero renders your content in the chosen layout (see `HeroContent`) instead of the designed sample, together with the props below.

members.name: install
members.doc: Install commands for your own content; the first one is shown with a copy button.

members.name: media
members.doc: A visual beside your own content in the split layout.

members.name: meta
members.doc: Small facts under your own content, such as the version and license.

members.name: highlight
members.doc: Kept for compatibility; highlighted phrases render as plain text.

members.name: label
members.doc: Text of the link.

members.name: href
members.doc: Where it goes. Without it the entry is a button that only calls `onClick`.

members.name: onClick
members.doc: Called on press.

members.name: brand
members.doc: Product name beside the mark.

members.name: mark
members.doc: A small glyph drawn on the accent tile, in the accent's text color.

members.name: brandHref
members.doc: Where the brand links to. Without it the brand is plain text.

members.name: links
members.doc: Section links. They hide on narrow screens.

members.name: signIn
members.doc: The quiet entry on the right, such as "Sign in". Hides on narrow screens.

members.name: action
members.doc: The button on the right.

members.name: animateIn
members.doc: Fades the bar in on mount. Defaults to true.

members.name: children
members.doc: The phrase to mark. Keep it short: it never breaks across lines.

members.name: animateIn
members.doc: Draws the marker in from the left on mount. Defaults to true; reduced motion shows it drawn.

members.name: external
members.doc: Opens in a new tab and shows an outward arrow.

members.name: doneLabel
members.doc: Shown in place of the label for a moment after a press, such as "Trial started". Buttons only.

members.name: label
members.doc: Short label, such as npm or pnpm. The first command is shown.

types.name: LumenRange
types.doc: Sample data for Lumen, a revenue analytics product. Replace it with your own product's numbers.

members.name: byRange
members.type: Record<LumenRange, { value: string; change: string; data: number[] }>

members.name: mono
members.doc: Mono marks draw in the text color through a mask; color marks keep their own colors.
